title: Counter Turing machine
statement: Define a one-work-tape deterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with states $0,1,2,3$ and initial state $0$. In state $0$, on a blank input cell it stays put, does not write or move its work-tape head, emits nothing, and enters state $3$; on a nonblank input cell it uses the counter tape update action with input-head movement right. In state $1$ it uses that update action with input-head movement zero. In state $2$, it stays on the input and, if the work cell is blank, moves the work head right without writing and enters state $0$; otherwise it moves the work head left without writing and remains in state $2$. In state $3$, if the work cell is blank it halts without moving or writing; otherwise it moves the work head right, writes the scanned bit to the output, and remains in state $3$.
